title: Onprem airgap: add offline bundle vendoring for SUSE MicroOS + rke2 compatibility
author: Elena Martinez
description: Motivation: Customers running on SUSE MicroOS with rke2 reported issues installing the air-gapped offline bundle due to a combination of packaging differences and missing systemd unit tweaks. This PR introduces a vendor-mode offline bundle for SUSE MicroOS, rke2 compatibility patches, and updates the airgap installer to select the appropriate artifact set based on detected distro. Scope: 1) Add SUSE MicroOS-specific vendor folder with packaged images and RPMs; 2) Add rke2-flavored manifests and systemd unit templates (rke2.service tweaks for MicroOS); 3) Installer changes: distro detection, artifact resolution, and improved checksum verification; 4) Helm chart values adjustments for offline installs (imagePullPolicy, registry mirror defaults); 5) Documentation updates and an end-to-end validation job for the CI airgap matrix. Backwards compatibility: The default offline bundle remains unchanged for rke2/rke2-flatcar users. New variable offline_bundle.vendor=distro_name enables explicit selection. Testing: validated end-to-end on a local MicroOS VM and on our rke2 acceptance cluster. Checklist: - [x] Add vendor bundle and packaging scripts - [x] Installer logic for distro detection and artifact resolution - [x] rke2 manifest and systemd unit adjustments - [x] CI matrix job added and green - [x] Docs and release notes updated - [x] Manual validation on SUSE MicroOS and rke2 cluster
